lessons: PLATE v1 FAILED SUBJECT VERIFICATION. Naming a part does not generate it. 'swan-neck rear wing' returned a generic GT wing on STRAIGHT PEDESTALS FROM BELOW, and 'canards' returned a bare bumper. 4cr wasted.

PLATE v2 PASSED by DESCRIBING THE GEOMETRY instead of naming it: 'two curved arms rise from the deck, arch UP and OVER the wing, bolt to its UPPER surface, NOTHING underneath' produced a correct swan-neck. 'two small angled fins stacked one above the other on each bumper corner' produced correct canards.
GENERALISATION: for any named trim part, write the shape and the mounting, plus a negative naming the wrong version. Jargon is not a spec.
Matt black paint generated well first time from 'ABSORBS light, form through soft sheen and edge highlights, NOT glossy reflections'.
WATCH: v2 has a softbox visible top-left and the wing hardware reads polished metal rather than carbon weave. Neither is identity-breaking; both were declared before generation, not discovered after.

The Supra has no door theatre like the i8's butterfly doors, so the 2-second event is HUMAN: Nev drops in, door thumps, straight-six fires and the car shakes. A face at second zero - the thing the LC300 never had.

2026-08-05 BED BAND MISMATCH: the whole 25-track BGM library is 140-165 BPM drift phonk (car_cinematic). travel_vlog measured 95-115 BPM across 6 references. NOTHING is reusable across these two pillars - a phonk bed under a vlog repeats the Crown's '90 BPM marimba under a car edit' error in the opposite direction. BGM/ is now one folder per PILLAR KEY (car_cinematic/ travel_vlog/ industry/) so a bed can be resolved from a plan's PILLAR with no lookup table.

2026-08-05 BEAT-GRID MATH IS PER-BPM, not per-plan-template: BEATS={burst:2,med:4,hold:8} copied from a 150 BPM car plan into a 105 BPM vlog turns burst into 1.14s (which happens to MATCH travel_vlog's measured 1.13s median - the genre math fits beautifully) but turns hold into 4.57s = 4x the median and ~20% of a 23s video on one image. Also at 105 BPM a 'med' hook is 2.29s and FAILS planqc 9's <=2.00s rule, so a vlog hook can only be a burst. planqc 2b now SURFACES the longest shot as a ratio of the genre median and as a share of the video - a warn, never a block, because the car's own hold was 4.2x its median and his eye approved it. The number must be seen at plan time, not discovered in the finished cut.

2026-08-05 FREE-VLOG-MUSIC GENRE GAP: the material clusters at 90-99 BPM (half-time chill/lofi) and 117-140 (house/tropical). travel_vlog's measured 95-115 band is the TROUGH between the two clusters. Sourcing by mood tag ('chill','lofi') lands in the low cluster; 'summer'/tropical lands in the high one. Both are reachable under the +-8% rule, which is why switching the second batch to the summer tag doubled the yield. Also measured: all 19 tracks were stereo with 10.6-18.5dB dynamics - tempo was the ONLY rejecting filter, so tempo is the only thing worth targeting when sourcing.

general craft._what: PILLAR-INDEPENDENT craft: measurement design, tooling behaviour, process. TRUE FOR EVERY PILLAR. Learned mostly on car_cinematic because that is where the work happened first - filing them there made every later pillar start blind. planqc 23 now requires EVERY plan to acknowledge this topic.
general craft._rule: A lesson belongs here if it would still be true for a food vlog, a talking-head explainer, or a genre nobody has shot yet. If it names a BPM, an instrument, a car part or a place, it is GENRE and stays with its pillar.
lessons: speed ramp and masking are transitions I have code for but have NEVER looked at
VIEWED transitions frame-by-frame for the first time: whip reads as a DEFOCUS not a pan - blur is isotropic, no directional streak, no frame translation
mask transition produces NO visible mask - it is a straight cut
zoomblur produces no visible zoom blur - also a straight cut
2 of 3 transitions do nothing visible. Wiring them into the Crown would NOT have fixed his complaint
a real whip needs LINEAR directional blur along the pan axis + rapid frame translation, not boxblur
dense frame strips (every frame across the seam) are the ONLY way to review a transition - 3 stills cannot show motion

2026-08-04 FOLEY WORKS (his verdict on WRX v3): diegetic layer = extract each shot's audio from its OWN clip window, plan-gained (FOLEY={shot:gain_db}), 3-layer mix with bed hard-duck under the hero. MANDATORY: mastermind plans SOUND/FOLEY blocks BEFORE spend (planqc 19 blocks without it). 0 credits - the audio is already paid for at generation.

2026-08-04 DUPLICATES: dedupe WINDOWS not peaks. Allocator hands out non-overlapping windows per source (BAN_SPANS + manifest); verify 'far repeats' cross-checks every shot pair at pixel level; planqc 21 blocks source overcommit at plan time.

2026-08-04 REAL BGM: a real track has an ARRANGEMENT - engine now scans beat-aligned start offsets and rides the most continuous segment (his ear caught the breakdown landing mid-video as 'silent 1-2s / track switching'). Bed gain rides the segment's mean level (a hotter segment re-broke true-peak). Phase = FITTED grid over all onsets, never just the first transient (swung intros).

2026-08-04 TEMPO STRETCH: verify the STRETCHED file's tempo by fine grid-fit sweep - the first naive 139.7->150 stretch landed at 149.5 and beat-lock failed at 45.8ms median. Sped-phonk (asetrate) is on-genre for <=8%.

2026-08-04 MEASUREMENT-DESIGN lessons (BLUR-bug family): (a) sfx-lift >=2dB is unmeasurable over a dense mastered bed with beat-locked cuts - the control window contains the bed's own next hit; amended: if >=70% cuts sit ON music onsets the music marks the cut, require only 'not masked'. (b) bedqc spectrum: phonk BEDS are 70-89% sub-low BY GENRE (measured his 25 tracks); the 45%-body reference profile applies to the FULL MIX only.

2026-08-04 AAC OVERSHOOT: the encoder overshoots true-peak +1..3.4dB on sub-heavy material; sample-peak before encode is NOT the delivered peak. Master chain: mix HP30 (subsonics only feed the codec) + relimit; always measure the DELIVERED aac.

2026-08-04 CUT-TOO-EARLY: allocator now prefers windows whose END motion is <80% of peak motion (action RESOLVED inside the window). Blends never touch an EVENT boundary (planqc 20) - the v1 blend dissolved the swerve-pass.

2026-08-04 ORGANIZER (his design): ingest.py catalogs every delivered clip (role, peaks, settle, audio level, ban spans, bright-rig suspects) into clips/manifest.json; engine allocates from it, verify 12 tallies the finished cut against the plan. Auto-detections are SUSPECTS for the eye, never binding bans.

2026-08-04 MUSIC 'BREAKS AT CUTS' (his ear, v4): two mechanisms - binary hard-duck windows STEP 12dB in/out, and thr.03/ratio8 sidechain gates the bed under every whoosh. Fix: ONE smooth sidechain keyed by sfx+foley summed (thr.06/ratio6/release120) - the loud launch foley ducks the bed BY ITSELF, no windows. Remaining arrangement gaps covered by plan SFX_OVERLAYS: snippets from the clips' OWN audio (idle swell under Nev's hold, spray under the payoff), 0 credits, diegetic-true. Quiet source material (idle) must sit HOT (-0.5dB, not -5). Verified: dips >=6dB/0.25s went 2 -> 0.

2026-08-04 'SANDY SOUND at beat cuts' (his ear, v5): the whoosh layer is a white-noise sweep - at +18dB (synth-bed-era gain never re-calibrated for the real bed) it reads as sand. Back to 13.5. RULE: when the bed changes, RE-CALIBRATE EVERY layer gain against it, not just the bed's own. Gates after: -9.1 LUFS, -1.7 dBTP, beat 10.1ms/88%, dips 0.

2026-08-04 WHOOSH SAND, root cause (his ear v6): at the CUT MOMENT the sidechain ducks the bed while the whoosh plays on top - so the whoosh IS louder than the music exactly there, even when its average RMS sits 6dB under. Average-level comparisons miss moment balance. Whoosh placement 0.34 -> 0.15 (impacts/subs keep weight). SECOND normalize-up trap found the same minute: sfxgen scaled the whole track to 0.72 peak, so quieter whooshes BOOSTED the impacts +2.3dB (TP +2.4 regression) - placement gains ARE the design, peak-scale down only, same rule as foley.

2026-08-04 SOUND ENGINEER AUTOMATED (his order, v7 review): engine now MEASURES每 layer's active RMS at mix gain and trims to target RELATIONSHIPS vs the bed anchor: edit-sfx -> bed-6 (marks cuts), foley foreground -> bed-2 (Nev/hero moments read). First run proved the complaint: foreground foley sat 19dB under the bed (inaudible exhale); trimmed +8 (clamp - clip audio amplified further = noise). No more hand-tuned layer constants; the calibration table prints as evidence every build. If Nev still needs more: raise plan FOLEY gains (design) rather than the clamp.

2026-08-04 INVENTED BADGE (mastermind QC file 27, first run, on WRX v8): a red 'SR' script sits in G's licence-plate recess - no such Subaru badge exists, exactly J4's 'wrong badge = the whole video is a joke' territory - and it shipped through 8 builds because every gate measures geometry/motion and a strip-scale eye pass cannot READ text. Mechanized same day: (a) clipqc writes 2x text-zoom crops (analysis/textzoom_<key>.png) for every EXTERIOR/PAYOFF/EVENT clip - the EYE must read every legible string, invented text = reject or patch; (b) engine consumes plan DELOGO={shot:(x,y,w,h)} at segment render, before the single final encode - free. v8: shot 15 box measured (union x386-469 y622-639 + margin); shot 4's badge measured illegible and was left alone. Minimal intervention beats regeneration (22.5cr saved).

2026-08-05 VERSION MONOTONIC (red-team): engine's default output was hardcoded _v1 and OVERWROTE the approved v1 the night the delogo build ran (original v1 lost - history is evidence). Default now scans the output dir and takes the next free version; a build may never clobber an existing file. The delogo rebuild itself is preserved as v9.

2026-08-05 PLAN-LITERAL HOLES (red-team wave 1, 3 hostile plans passed planqc): (a) DELOGO fully out of frame -> cryptic ffmpeg death mid-render; (b) SFX_OVERLAYS reading past clip EOF -> ffmpeg extracts SHORT silently, the dip the overlay covers ships uncovered; (c) CJK/emoji cards pass word-count and render as identical TOFU boxes in fallback fonts (same .notdef bbox for different glyphs is the tell). planqc 25 'field sanity' blocks all three; engine additionally refuses a corrupt DELOGO loudly.

2026-08-05 STALE CACHE IDENTITY (red-team wave 2): segment and blend cache specs matched on basenames+params only. A segment RE-RENDERED in place (same c06.mp4 name, new content) still matched the cached blend spec -> the seam ships the OLD pixels; a re-downloaded clip with the same basename would serve a stale segment the same way. The delogo build dodged it only because shot 15 touches no blend. Both specs now carry content identity (size+mtime) of their inputs.

2026-08-05 FOLEY AUDIBILITY (red-team wave 3): a spec-correct but SILENT clip on a FOREGROUND foley shot passed clipqc; engine prints 'NO clip carried audio' and builds anyway - the genre's sound design thins silently. clipqc now gates: any source mixed >= -6dB must carry an audio stream with mean > -45dB. Corruption classes (truncated/0-byte/black/wrong-spec) all already fail LOUD - that part held.

2026-08-05 VACUOUS PASS (red-team wave 4, the biggest class of the day): verify.py run without its build context printed OK on 8 of 13 checks that had measured NOTHING - '0/0 cuts (0%)', 'no CARDS found', 'no peak manifest', 'no plan module' all counted as PASS, so a wrong or stale file could be blessed. Doctrine now enforced in code: A CHECK THAT CANNOT MEASURE MUST FAIL, wording 'NOT MEASURED - <why>'. Same sweep found --project was parsed but never used (paths were fixed at import to the lc300 default; --project wrx verified against the wrong project) - now recomputed in main(). Absence of evidence is a BLOCK, never an OK.

2026-08-05 PILLAR PORTABILITY (found BEFORE writing the first vlog plan, by running a probe plan through planqc): planqc CRASHED with KeyError 'blended_range' on the first non-car_cinematic plan ever submitted. Only car_cinematic was fully measured; travel_vlog carries blended_pct 0 + 'HARD CUTS ONLY' and no ranges, industry has no blend_width_ms, neither has shot_mix. check_blends now derives an honest band from what the profile DOES hold (measured 0% becomes an editorial rule: band [0,5], deviation named in the detail) and never judges a width band when there are zero blends. GENERAL RULE: every gate must be read once against EVERY pillar profile before that pillar's first plan - a check tuned on one pillar is a check untested on the others.

2026-08-05 BED SOURCING, measured limits: Claude cannot download music in either environment - the cloud container's allowlist refuses every music host tested (incompetech, pixabay CDN, FMA, archive.org, ccmixter, bensound) and device_bash has no network by design. Higgsfield generate_audio is TTS-only and explicitly declines general music. Therefore beds arrive by: Gavril downloading them, or TikTok's Commercial Music Library (tiktok_music_trending -> music_sound_id at tiktok_publish, licensed, attached at publish not baked in). Baking a famous track into the mp4 invites Content ID muting - fatal for a sound-led genre.

2026-08-05 SILENT INHERITANCE — the architecture lesson, and the real answer to 'do we split editing styles?'. The split axis is NOT the pillar (4) but the FAMILY (2): PILLAR-PROFILES.json already declared family=short_music_led (car_cinematic, travel_vlog) vs long_speech_led (car_review, industry), and NO CODE HAD EVER READ IT. car_cinematic and travel_vlog run the SAME algorithm with different NUMBERS; only speech-led needs a second editor (transcript spine). The danger was never the styles clashing - it was that the CAR style was hardcoded as the invisible default, so a new pillar inherited it in silence. Three measured leaks: clipqc's night band 18-90 REJECTS daylight footage (measured 142-165 -> 'regenerate, 22.5cr'); engine laid a whoosh/impact on EVERY cut with no pillar check; planqc 19 was scoped `!= car_cinematic` so a vlog could reach SPEND with no sound decision at all. Fixed: every pillar declares a style block (brightness_band + source, edit_sfx, sound_gate, cut_spine, card_style), clipqc/engine/planqc read it, and planqc 26 BLOCKS any pillar declaring none. GENERAL RULE: the first pillar's taste must never become the second pillar's default - style is declared, never inherited.

2026-08-05 CRAFT vs SIGNATURE (the hybrid question, answered by stage audit): of engine's 12 stages, 9 are CRAFT and transfer to any music-led pillar UNCHANGED - window allocator (non-overlapping, ban spans, action-centering, resolved-motion preference), shot-match, adjacency/coverage, bed segment scan, fitted grid phase, beat lock, sound-engineer layer calibration, master chain (HP30/limiter/LUFS/TP), and every verify gate. 2 are already plan-parameterized (grade, cards). Exactly ONE is car SIGNATURE and must switch off: edit-sfx (whoosh/impact/sub-drop on cuts) - plus the hero-foley doctrine inside check 19, now gated to sound_gate=diegetic. So the vlog HYBRID is not a compromise, it is ~90% of the system: the vlog inherits all the craft and none of the taste. Beat-locked cutting in particular is a genuine skill transfer - travel_vlog is music-led too, it just runs at 95-115 BPM instead of 140-165. PROVISIONAL values must announce themselves (26b) so a guessed number is never mistaken for a measured one.

2026-08-05 WRONG-GENRE BED, the worst find of the day (predicted then PROVEN before any vlog existed): find_bed's last resort globbed assets/bgm/**/*.wav and picked the LARGEST file. A travel_vlog plan at 105 BPM resolved to the WRX's bed_skrrt_slide_150.wav - 150 BPM phonk - and the build would have printed SUCCESS. Every downstream gate would then have measured a beat-locked, correctly-mastered video that was a car soundtrack under holiday footage; only an ear would have caught it. TWO fixes: (1) find_bed is PILLAR-AWARE - projects/<name>/audio, then BGM/<pillar>/, then assets/bgm/*<BPM>*; the catch-all glob is DELETED on purpose, because no bed fails loudly while a wrong bed ships. (2) NEW verify_bed_tempo gate: the chosen bed's tempo is MEASURED and compared to the plan (2% tol, half/double-time accepted as the same grid) and the build REFUSES on mismatch. Verified: the WRX bed measures 149.8 -> BUILD at plan 150, REFUSE at plan 105 (43% off), BUILD at plan 75 (0.5x). It also independently re-confirmed yesterday's asetrate stretch was accurate.

2026-08-05 MOTION FLOOR IS GENRE TASTE (predicted, then measured, before any vlog clip was generated): clipqc's delivered-window floor of 1.5 was tuned on car footage - launches, spray, tracking moves. MEASURED on synthetic camera moves over a still: slow landscape drift 1.18, serene push-in 3.38, slow pan 4.74, locked-off tripod 0.00. So a legitimate SERENE travel shot would have been REJECTED as a dead clip at 22.5cr each. In a travel vlog a calm hold IS content; in a car edit it is a failure. motion_floor + event_motion_floor now live in the style block (car 1.5/4.0 MEASURED, vlog 0.6/2.5 PROVISIONAL from synthetic tests). Verified both directions: the serene clip passes as travel_vlog and still fails as car_cinematic. GENERAL RULE for every threshold in the codebase: ask whether it encodes PHYSICS (keep it global) or TASTE (move it to the style block) - 1.5 looked like physics and was taste.

2026-08-05 BED USABILITY IS A REACH TEST, NOT A MEMBERSHIP TEST. First reading of the travel_vlog bank asked 'is the native tempo inside 95-115?' and scored 3/19. The correct question is 'can it REACH the band within the +-8% stretch the WRX proved safe (Skrrt Slide +7.73% asetrate, on-genre)?' - which makes the real acceptance window native 88-124 and scores the SAME bank 14/19. Nearly five times the yield from re-reading the rule, zero extra downloads. The plan's BPM is then set to the CHOSEN bed (7 of the 14 need zero stretch), never the reverse. Generalises: before sourcing more material, check whether the FILTER is wrong.

2026-08-05 BROWSER AS THE DOWNLOAD ARM: with both Claude environments network-blocked, Claude in Chrome on Gavril's own machine is the working path - fetch the mp3 in-page as a blob and trigger a save (navigating to an .mp3 URL only plays it inline; it does not download). Chrome silently blocks MULTIPLE automatic downloads until the user clicks Allow once - the blocked batch then lands all at once. A 45s CDP timeout kills any awaited loop, so fire downloads as background setTimeout tasks and poll the folder from the device side. Files land in Downloads and must be COPIED (the bridge cannot delete). LICENCE DISCIPLINE: chosic tracks are commercial-use-free ONLY with attribution; capture the credit line and licence per track at download time, and prefer plain CC BY over CC BY-SA (share-alike).

2026-08-05 READINESS PROBE (write a throwaway plan and gate it BEFORE committing to a title): a realistic 16-shot travel_vlog plan at 97.5 BPM surfaced three failures of three different KINDS, which is exactly why the probe is worth writing. (1) AUTHORING errors - 4 cropped shots in a row, an undeclared repeat framing: the gates worked, I was wrong. (2) TOOL GAP - planqc's card word limit was hardcoded 3 (label) / 5 (narrative), pure car taste; travel_vlog's own measured caption style is 'sentence fragments' and a real fragment ('SABAH, 1500 METRES UP') is 4 words, so the car limit BLOCKED the vlog genre's native caption form. Moved to style.card_max_words (car 3, vlog 6, speech-led 8). (3) THE GATE CAUGHT ME - LESSONS_ACK=51 (I summed all topics) was refused because the travel vlog topic holds 11; an invented count is worse than none, exactly as the check says.

2026-08-05 A DEFAULT MUST NEVER CAP A DECLARED DEVIATION: adding style.card_max_words immediately broke the WRX, whose CARD_STYLE='narrative' 5-word cards have shipped since 2026-08-04 as a DELIBERATE, declared deviation from the profile's 1-2 word labels. The style block sets the pillar DEFAULT; a plan's declared deviation must RAISE the ceiling, never be silently capped by it. Caught by regression in the same minute it was introduced - which is the argument for running every pillar's plan through planqc after touching any shared check.

2026-08-05 CROSS-PILLAR CRAFT GAP (surfaced, not yet fixed): LESSONS_ACK is per-topic by design, but most of what this system knows about MEASUREMENT - AAC overshoot, normalize-up traps, average-vs-moment, stale calibration - was learned under 'car cinematic' and applies to EVERY pillar. A travel_vlog plan acknowledging its own 11 lessons is ignoring 40 lessons of general craft. planqc 23b now WARNS with the other topics' counts. The real fix is a ledger refactor into a shared 'general craft' topic; until then the warn is the reminder.

2026-08-05 THE LEDGER REFACTOR (his order: 'fix it first'). 54 lessons were split by asking one question of each: WOULD THIS STILL BE TRUE FOR A GENRE NOBODY HAS SHOT YET? 36 said yes and moved here (measurement design, tooling behaviour, engine/gate behaviour, process); 18 stayed with their pillar (15 car, 3 vlog) because they name a BPM, an instrument, a car part or a place. Conservation checked: 36+15+3 == 54, nothing lost, and a backup was written before the move. planqc 23 now requires EVERY plan to acknowledge BOTH its genre topic AND 'general craft', as a dict {topic: count}; a bare int is read as the genre count and the missing craft ack BLOCKS. 23b downgraded to naming neighbouring pillars' genre lessons as optional prior art. WHY IT MATTERED: filing craft under the first pillar that learned it made every later pillar start blind - the travel_vlog plan was acking 11 lessons while ignoring 25 lessons about measurement that applied to it in full.

2026-08-05 THE LAST HEAD-BASED CHECK (found on the KK batch, cost 0 because it was caught before regenerating): clipqc's face-READ check still measured only the FIRST 1.5s, even though the delivered-window lesson had been applied to every other check on 2026-08-04. Clip H's prompt said 'watches the horizon, THEN turns to the lens' - the face read 1.3% in the head and 19.4% at 4.88s. The head-based gate called REJECT and would have burned 22.5cr regenerating a clip whose face beat was exactly where the prompt put it. Fixed: scan the WHOLE clip, score the best shot-length window. RULE: when a measurement-window lesson is learned, GREP FOR EVERY OTHER USE OF THAT WINDOW the same day - one survivor is enough to reproduce the whole bug class a day later.

2026-08-05 FACE-READ IS NOT FACE-MATCH (gap named, not yet closed): clipqc measures whether a face is BIG ENOUGH to read (>=3.5% of frame). It has no check for whether the face is THE REFERENCE PERSON. A generation can pass the size gate at 19% and still be a different man - the failure mode that J4 holds an absolute veto over, and the inverse of the Supra probe (which failed by being too small). Candidate mechanisation: embedding distance between the plate's face crop and the delivered window's face crop, thresholded, with Gavril's eye as the final arbiter.

2026-08-05 CLAUDE'S EYE IS UNRELIABLE FOR FACIAL IDENTITY - stated as a limit, not a excuse. On the KK human clips my verdict FLIPPED between two crop scales: at thumbnail scale in a 9-clip contact sheet I judged 'that is not Nev'; at matched scale beside the plate I judged 'plausibly him'. Same frames, same session, opposite conclusions. Therefore: identity verdicts are GAVRIL'S, always, and Claude's job is to put the evidence in front of him at a scale where a human can judge - plate crop and delivered-window crop, side by side, matched size - and to state that its own read is not evidence. Do not report an identity pass or fail as a finding.

2026-08-05 A MEASURED CONSTANT IS NOT A GUESSABLE ONE. KK v1 measured 9/19 cuts swinging >18 (worst 52) because a travel vlog spans golden hour to night by design. Diagnosis said shot_match lacked authority, so its clamp was raised 0.14 -> 0.26 for travel_vlog. RESULT: WORSE - 16/19 swings, worst 71. eq=brightness is not linear in mean luma, so a larger clamp OVERSHOOTS dark segments past the target rather than meeting it; the 0.14 was measured on the WRX and the 0.26 was invented. Reverted, re-measured, back to 9/19. The rule this proves: when a constant carries a MEASURED provenance comment, changing it requires a new measurement, not a plausible argument - and the cheapest way to find that out is to rebuild and re-measure immediately, which cost one build here instead of a shipped regression.

2026-08-05 EXPOSURE SWING IS INHERENT TO A TIME-OF-DAY ARC (named, not yet solved): a travel_vlog whose story IS the clock (6PM -> sunset -> dusk -> night) cuts between segments that legitimately differ by 60 luma. Measured on KK: clips ranged 74 (mosque dusk) to 135 (afternoon market). Three levers exist and all cost something - (a) reorder for luma continuity, which an optimiser cut swings 13->3 but opened the video at NIGHT and destroyed the card clock; (b) widen the grading clamp, which made it worse (above); (c) accept it as the evening's real light and declare the deviation. The generated clips' luma also does not track their intended hour - the 'night' clip read BRIGHTER than the 'dusk' one - so light state must become a PROMPT-level and INGEST-level measurement, not an assumption. Candidate fix for next build: pin each scenery prompt to an explicit lux/светlight description AND record luma_mean at ingest so planqc 24b can order the arc before generation.

2026-08-05 THE PLATE ANCHORS FRAMING, NOT JUST PLACE (Gavril's catch on KK v1: 'a few duplicated images/scenes and shots'). MEASURED root cause: sources A, C, E and I all cited the same waterfront plate with no camera position declared, and every one returned the PLATE'S OWN composition - a boardwalk receding to the sea. Shots 0/1/5/12/16 were ONE IMAGE seen five times, from THREE DIFFERENT SOURCES. A reference plate fixes the place; unqualified it also fixes the framing, and the model hands back the picture it was shown. FIX: planqc 28 requires every source to declare a FRAMING, and two sources sharing a plate may not share one - decidable at plan time, free, before a credit is spent. This is the cheapest possible place to catch it: by the time a cut exists the clips are already paid for.

2026-08-05 'DUPLICATE FEEL' MEASURED AT LAST - and two honest failures on the way. verify check 4 (repetition, across a cut) said 0/19 and check 10 (far repeats, pixel-level shared footage) said CLEAN, and BOTH WERE CORRECT: two non-overlapping windows of one static clip are genuinely distinct footage that still reads as the same shot. file 27 named this 'duplicate FEEL' and nothing measured it. FAILED ATTEMPT 1: raw-pixel NCC scored 0.76 on a pair the eye calls identical. FAILED ATTEMPT 2: pHash scored 0.62 on the same pair. Both were dominated by the time-of-day COLOUR shift while the FRAMING stayed identical. WHAT WORKED: a 4x4 grid of gradient-orientation histograms - deliberately blind to colour and exposure, answering only 'where are the lines'. It scored those pairs 0.91-0.96 and matched his eye exactly. Now verify check 13, comparing EVERY shot pair (the earlier same-source-only scoping was itself a miss, since the worst cluster spanned three sources). GENERAL: when a metric disagrees with his eye, the metric is the suspect - and the fix is usually to strip the dimension the eye is ignoring.

2026-08-05 INTERNAL VARIETY IS A GENERATION REQUIREMENT, not an edit problem. A source used N times needs a clip whose COMPOSITION CHANGES across its 5 seconds, or every window the allocator picks is the same picture. MEASURED on KK: the old locked-off palm-sunset had worst-pair self-similarity 0.975 (two windows essentially the same frame); regenerated with 'the camera TRACKS CONTINUOUSLY along the waterline, never the same framing twice' it dropped to 0.871 - below the duplicate threshold, so no two windows CAN read alike. Same for the night street: 0.990 -> 0.908. RULE: if a plan uses a source more than once, its prompt must specify continuous camera movement. Cheaper than regenerating after the eye catches it.

2026-08-05 CROP ASSIGNMENT CAN BE OVER-DETERMINED. planqc's crop rules (hook uncropped, per-source crops unique, runs <= 2, halves within 30 points) are individually cheap and jointly tight. On KK, adding ONE more constraint - two specific shots forced to crop >1.05 so CROP_XY could push gibberish signage out of frame - made the system INFEASIBLE, proved by exhaustive backtracking, not by guessing. When that happens the answer is not to loosen a measured rule; it is to change the SHOT (different source, or regenerate the clip). Diagnose infeasibility by dropping one constraint at a time - it names the binding one in seconds.

2026-08-05 A SILENT NO-OP IS WORSE THAN AN ERROR. A regex-driven plan edit reported 'patched 20' while the source swap it was supposed to make never applied - the wrong shot index was rewritten and the build ran on a plan nobody had actually changed. Caught only by reading the contact sheet and noticing shot 12 was still the old source. RULE: after any programmatic edit to a plan, READ THE EDITED LINES BACK and assert the change is present. A tool that reports success without verifying it is the same class as the vacuous-pass bug in verify.

2026-08-05 FILE 27 GAINS A PREDICTION PASS (his order: 'predict the bug before it appears, especially mastermind QC and each level of QC'). Every defect this system has shipped was found by EYE after a build; each now has a PART 0 question that would have caught it at PLAN time, free: P1 shared plate without distinct framings · P2 repeated source from a locked-off clip · P3 story spanning multiple light states · P4 signage/badges/screens in frame · P5 a threshold tuned on a different pillar · P6 bed from the wrong bank or unmeasured tempo · P7 a callback with no footage to land on · P8 changing a MEASURED constant. 2026-08-05 THE EDIT WAS GRADING A SECOND TIME, AND HE CAUGHT IT BY EYE BEFORE ANY GATE DID. His words: 'the lighting at some scenes are super dark where i can barely see the video... i think the video output from higgsfield lighting is already pretty good maybe the video editor edit for the second time on the lighting.' MEASURED on KK v14: the shot_match stage moved shots by up to 72.6 luma. kk_I arrived from the model at 44.4 mean luma - one of the three raw clips he called 'close to perfect' - and shipped at 116.9. Nine other shots were crushed by up to -46. ROOT CAUSE: gain = d/255*1.9 assumed ffmpeg eq=brightness moves a FIXED 134 luma per unit. The MEASURED response is 174-519 (mean 296, 3.0x spread, content dependent). Every correction therefore ran ~2.2x hot and 17 of 20 shots crossed the target and landed on the FAR side. FIX: closed loop - apply, RE-MEASURE the rendered file, correct once more using the response observed on THAT shot, and keep the untouched original as a candidate. Result v15: worst relight 72.6 -> 12.2 luma, range of the day kept at 79%.

2026-08-05 OPEN-LOOP CORRECTION IS THE BUG CLASS, NOT THE CONSTANT. A stage that computes a gain from a hardcoded transfer function and never looks at its own output is guessing, and the guess is invisible because the stage still prints a confident log line ('15/20 shots matched'). Any stage that ADJUSTS something must re-measure what it produced. Corollary, and this one cost a whole session: the earlier finding 'widening the clamp 0.14->0.26 made exposure WORSE (9->16 swings)' was NOT a fact about the clamp. It was this miscalibration - a wider clamp simply let the 2.2x overshoot run further. A measurement taken on top of a broken stage inherits the break. When a result is surprising, audit the instrument before you write the lesson.

2026-08-05 STATE EVERY BUDGET IN THE UNIT HE PERCEIVES. The authority for the relight stage was declared as 'shot_match_clamp 0.14' - an opaque ffmpeg parameter. Nobody, including me, could tell that 0.14 meant 41 luma on one clip and 73 on another, so an enormous edit read as a small number in a config file. The budget is now shot_match_max_move, stated in LUMA, and the clamp is only a second belt. If you cannot say what a parameter does in a unit a human can see, you do not know what it does.

2026-08-05 HIS APPROVAL BAND IS WIDER THAN ANY TARGET - MEASURE IT FROM WHAT HE PRAISES. He sent three raw Higgsfield clips and said 'the lighting are close to perfect'. They measured 45.1, 89.7 and 92.9 mean luma. A 47-luma spread is INSIDE his taste. The stage was pulling all 20 shots to a single median, so it was not improving consistency - it was deleting the day. Consistency belongs BETWEEN NEIGHBOURS (shave the excess swing at a cut); sameness across a whole video is a defect wearing a metric's clothes. shot_match_mode is now 'neighbour' on every pillar, and a RANGE KEPT % is reported - under ~70% the edit is flattening a day into one light state.

2026-08-05 TRUST THE MODEL'S OUTPUT UNTIL HE SAYS OTHERWISE. Higgsfield's lighting is a deliberate creative act he is paying for and approving. The edit's job is CONTINUITY, not taste. When delivered luma is far from source luma, the burden of proof is on the EDIT, never the source. Generalise beyond light: any stage that overwrites a model decision (colour, framing, pace, sound) must justify itself against what arrived, and the diff must be reportable.

2026-08-05 A SMOOTH METRIC CAN BE BOUGHT BY DESTROYING THE INPUT. Exposure-match (verify 5) scored well on v14 precisely BECAUSE it was flattening his footage; the check that was supposed to protect quality was rewarding the defect. Ask of every PASSING check: what did it have to break to pass? Check 5 now carries that warning inline and points at check 15 as the harder limit.

2026-08-05 AND READ BOTH DIRECTIONS OF A ONE-DIRECTION COMPLAINT. He reported 'too dark', so the instinct was to hunt for crushing. The same bug had blown a 44-luma night shot to 117 - the brighter failure was the larger error and would have been missed entirely, because bright reads as 'fine' in a thumbnail. A complaint names where it hurt, not the extent of the bug.

2026-08-05 HIS INSTRUCTION ON HOW TO HOLD ALL OF THIS: 'dont lock it i want you to learn from it so next time you know how to analyze these stuff, learn it learn to analyze and see it and sense it, these are to upgrade your senses' and 'all the feedbacks i given is to teach you where went wrong so you can learn and improve this automation'. A threshold that BLOCKS gets obeyed and stops being thought about. So verify 15 reports and does not block, and tools/lightsense.py renders the same measurement as a side-by-side picture at MATCHED SCALE so the judgement stays with an eye. The general form: when a miss is a missing PERCEPTION, build the instrument that makes it visible; a gate alone only stops the one instance you already understand.

2026-08-05 LINKAGE IS A STATE CHANGE THAT SURVIVES THE CUT, NOT A RESEMBLANCE BETWEEN TWO SHOTS. His doctrine, verbatim: 'there must be a linkage that is important, when there is linkage then it feels like a story'. KK v15 declared 19 linkages, planqc 24 passed all 19, and the eye found 5 that land. Reading them back, 14 were descriptions of RESEMBLANCE - 'same light temperature', 'same blue hour', 'two stillnesses'. Resemblance is CONTINUITY: it stops a cut being jarring. It cannot make a story, because nothing is different on the far side of it. Only CONSEQUENCE makes a story: B happens BECAUSE of A. Shot A must leave the world different from how it found it and shot B must inherit that difference. Measured corroboration: 9 of 20 shots had optical flow under 0.6 and nothing happened to the person in 28 seconds - there was no state for any boundary to carry.

2026-08-05 A LINKAGE MUST NAME A TOKEN FINDABLE IN BOTH SHOTS' WRITING, OR IT EXISTS ONLY IN MY HEAD. The killer example, decidable from the plan text for FREE: boundary 15->16 declared 'the car returns: callback in the same gold light' while the shot note for 16 said 'boardwalk at dusk - THE PLACE, EMPTIED'. The plan contradicted itself in writing and shipped, one build after P7 (a callback with no footage to land on) was added to file 27. planqc 24 counted that a string existed; it never read the string against the two shots it joined. LINKAGE is now (kind, token, prose) with kind in motion/gaze/subject/object/light/sound/consequence, and planqc 29 requires the token to appear in the writing of BOTH adjacent shots. Prose entries are reported UNVERIFIABLE, never OK.

2026-08-05 A LINKAGE BUILT ON A VERB NEEDS A CLIP THAT PERFORMS THE VERB. Five KK boundaries were built on walking, rising, drifting, exiting, heat-motion. Measured optical flow: shot 2 'Nev walking toward lens' = 0.50 (standing still); boundary 11->12 'heat motion to light motion' = 0.40 -> 0.51 (neither moves). You cannot cut on a motion handoff when neither side moves. Motion-kind linkages must declare a floor and have it checked at clip QC, before the cut is assembled.

2026-08-05 THE LINKAGE LIST MUST BE GENERATED FROM THE FINAL SHOT ORDER, NEVER AUTHORED BESIDE IT. KK's 19 linkages were written against the storyboard's intended order. The built cut re-used all 9 sources 2-3x each, so boundary 12->13 was literally boundary 5->6 a second time, and half the list described a video that was never assembled. Same root cause as the storyboard showing 9 SOURCES instead of the 20-shot CUT: every relational artefact - linkage, repetition, the card clock - is a property of the ORDER, and must be derived from it after the order is fixed.

2026-08-05 DECLARE THE CLOCK OR THE CUT WILL BREAK IT. KK v15 ran golden -> night -> DAYLIGHT -> sunset -> morning -> night -> golden with a '6PM IN KK BAH' card on screen over the noon footage. The plan's own premortem promised 'no cut jumps backwards in time' and nothing enforced it, because no shot ever declared what time it was. planqc 30: every shot names a light state from an ORDERED vocabulary (dawn/morning/midday/afternoon/golden/dusk/blue/night); going backwards or skipping 3+ states FAILS unless the boundary is listed in TIME_JUMPS with a reason. A declared jump is a choice; an undeclared one is the continuity break he reads as 'no story'.

2026-08-05 APPROVAL SCOPE INFLATION - the most dangerous bug in this system, because it forges the warrant for every other number. He corrected me: 'no i did not approve number 3 i just approved one of the scene inside'. I had recorded a whole-video approval where he had said he liked ONE SCENE, then used that inflated approval as ground truth. His eye is the ONLY ground truth here - every metric I own is validated against it - so widening an approval quietly manufactures evidence. An audit found 'approved' 13 times in the repo; most could not produce the quote that earned it. RULE: an approval needs the VERBATIM words, the exact SCOPE, and what it does NOT cover, recorded in ledgers/approvals.json. 'He approved X' with no quote is banned. A partial positive is a SCENE-level approval and may NEVER be promoted to artefact level.

2026-08-05 A CHECK VALIDATED AT ONE END IS NOT CALIBRATED, IT IS MERELY NOT YET CONTRADICTED. I reported that planqc 31 (consequence spine) was calibrated because WRX passed and KK failed, matching his eye at both ends. The positive endpoint was my own invention - he never approved WRX. The real result is single-ended: KK scored 0 and he disliked KK. A metric that only separates one known-bad case from nothing has not been shown to discriminate. Keep it non-blocking and say so, rather than presenting one endpoint as two.

2026-08-05 AUDIT THE PROVENANCE WORDS, NOT JUST THE NUMBERS. Constants in this repo carry justification strings - 'MEASURED', 'approved', 'eye-validated'. Those words are load-bearing: they are the reason a future session will or will not re-examine the number. A constant labelled 'approved' looks settled and gets left alone. Grep the provenance vocabulary periodically and demand the evidence for each hit; the ones that cannot produce it are the constants most likely to be wrong AND least likely to be questioned. Found this way: clipqc's EVENT motion floor 4.0, a BLOCKING gate that rejects clips at 22.5cr, justified by an approval with no quote behind it.

TRAVEL_VLOG'S MOTION_FLOOR 0.6 AND BRIGHTNESS_BAND 35-200 ARE THEREFORE STILL PROVISIONAL TWO BUILDS LATER - THE DELIVERED CUT MEASURES 1.41-9.42 MOTION AND 56.6-133.1 LUMA BUT THAT IS POST-GRADE OUTPUT, NOT CLIPQC'S RAW INPUT, SO IT CANNOT LEGALLY REPLACE THEM.: MEASUREMENT SOURCE DESTROYED - the raw clips are the only way to re-derive a PROVISIONAL threshold, and every kk_*.mp4 was deleted after KK v15 shipped. projects/kk/clips/ holds manifest.json and an empty _to_delete. travel_vlog's motion_floor 0.6 and brightness_band 35-200 are therefore STILL provisional two builds later - the delivered cut measures 1.41-9.42 motion and 56.6-133.1 luma but that is post-grade OUTPUT, not clipqc's raw input, so it cannot legally replace them. 2026-08-06 SOUND LAYER CONTRACT - THERE IS NO PER-SHOT SFX STACK: engine.py:819-855 reads FOLEY = {shot: gain_db}, ONE gain per shot, applied to that CLIP'S OWN generated audio. Plus one bed and, under edit_sfx=hero_only, exactly one transient at SOUND['hero_shot']. Three layers total. 2026-08-06 TRANSITION BANK IS PILLAR-GATED, NOT ABSENT - AND SAYING 'THERE ARE NO TRANSITIONS' WAS WRONG: tools/fx.py holds 14 built transitions (dip, dissolve, dolly_in, dolly_out, flash, glitch, mask_circle, mask_crop, mask_radial, mask_slice, mask_wipe, speedramp, whip, zoomblur) and engine.py:596 dispatches them live via fx.FX[BLEND_KIND]. car_cinematic uses them at a measured 27%. travel_vlog declares ZERO because refstudy measured 0% blended in 5 of 6 references - an editorial finding about the GENRE, not a missing capability. MITIGATION: storyboard.py now prints the pillar's measured blended_pct on every hard-cut row, so the page states WHY there is no transition instead of implying none can exist. When answering what a plan does, name the pillar and the measurement that set it.

2026-08-06 BLEND BAND IS PERCENT-DERIVED AND QUANTISES TO ZERO ON SHORT CUTS: planqc 11 derives the band [0,5]% when a profile's blended_pct is 0. At 20 shots there are 19 boundaries, so ONE blend = 5.3% and BLOCKS. The plan therefore cannot declare even a single deliberate whip, which is a QUANTISATION ARTIFACT of expressing an editorial rule as a percentage, not a decision anyone made. Compounding it, travel_vlog_ANALYSIS.md line 86 states the blend detector 'catches wipes and fades reliably, but a very fast whip can read as a hard cut' - and a fast whip is exactly the transition a vlog would use. The measured range is 0-28 across 6 refs: five at 0, one at 28. MITIGATION: OPEN, HIS CALL, and evidence first: re-measure the 6 travel_vlog references with a whip-sensitive detector before changing anything. If 0% survives, keep hard cuts. If whips were undercounted, the band belongs in COUNT not percent for cuts under ~25 boundaries - and that is a planqc change, never an autonomous edit.

2026-08-06 THE BLEND DETECTOR WAS BLIND TO WHIPS AND SET A PILLAR TO ZERO: travel_vlog carried blended_pct 0 from a frame-difference heuristic that its OWN analysis file flags at line 86 - 'catches wipes and fades reliably, but a very fast whip can read as a hard cut'. A fast whip is exactly the transition a vlog uses. Re-measured 2026-08-06 with tools/blendsense.py, which separates a WHIP (sharpness trench of 2-6 frames WITH a scene change across it) from a hard cut (no trench) and a dissolve (sustained mid correlation): the same 6 references hold 3 whips and 1 dissolve in 42 cuts = 9.5% pooled, 3 of 6 refs using at least one. The 0% was an UNDERCOUNT, and it had switched off a 14-transition bank that engine.py:596 dispatches live. MITIGATION: when a measurement sets a pillar-wide editorial rule, the DETECTOR's own stated blind spot must be tested before the rule is trusted. travel_vlog now declares designed_pct 9.5, designed_kinds ['whip'] and blend_max_count 2; planqc 11 gained a COUNT band and a kind whitelist. Per-file medians are useless at n=6 with 1-2 cut outliers - pool the cuts.

2026-08-06 THE MIX COMPLAINT WAS REAL BUT NOT WHERE IT WAS REPORTED - MEASURE BOTH PILLARS BEFORE TOUCHING EITHER: he said 'the sfx and foley are too loud it covers the whole bgm'. Flat RMS proved nothing (KK foreground shots were only +0.6dB over background) because a sidechained bed keeps TOTAL level constant while the MUSIC disappears underneath. The signature is spectral: during the loudest 10 percent of broadband moments the bed's 40-160Hz band drops -4.9dB on KK v15 (travel_vlog, hero_only) but -31.1dB on WRX v9 (car_cinematic, edit_sfx=full). -31dB is the bed being removed under every whoosh, not ducked. Cause: foley foreground was targeted at bed-2 and edit-sfx at bed-6 as HARDCODED constants, with a 0.06/6:1 sidechain, for every pillar alike. MITIGATION: engine.py now reads mix_sfx_target_db, mix_foley_fg_target_db, mix_duck_threshold, mix_duck_ratio and mix_duck_release from the PILLAR's style block, DEFAULTING to the old constants so every existing pillar builds identically. travel_vlog declares foley foreground at bed-8 and a 3:1 duck at 0.10. car_cinematic is UNCHANGED and OPEN - retuning it would change the approved WRX look, so it is his call with the -31.1dB number in hand.

'Chill' removes the usual car-edit event vocabulary (launches, drifts, anti-lag), so the chill dialect MUST find its event inside the car itself - a powertrain, a light, a door, a state that flips - or it has no spine at all.
